name: Extreme Space Cab v1.0
author: Sharkitty
description:
This Game was made by Hayley GUILLOT (Sharkitty) and Nigel BLOEMENDAL (SurudoiRyu)

In this futuristic open world city, people need space cabs to get around, and you're the best one out there!

With your sporty hovering car, take clients and bring them to their destination. You gotta go fast while avoiding other space cars and pedestrians 
to keep your clients happy and get lots of Cyber Bucks!

Don't wreck your car!
Hitting stuff will damage it, and if you get too much damage: It's GAME OVER!
Watch out not to break stuff or you'll have to pay a fee!

Use your well earned money at the garage to repair your car and get upgrades!
These upgrades change your stats and are visible on your space cab, which makes it look way cooler!

This game feature:
- An open world futuristic city with custom made assets.
- An awesome space cab created solely for this game.
- An upgrade system that changes your cab model to make it look more impressive on top of the stat improvements.
- A fully functionnal UI with custom digital painted sprites.
- A random job system and working economy.
- NPCs get mad at you when you hit them.
- Damage and repair system.
- Real Hover physics.
- You can boost or make an impulse that makes your cab jump.

Now take the wheel and go make lots of Cyber Bucks!

Note: Since I got sick during the last week we had to develop this game, we got delayed and there has been a big rush at the end. Some part of the map may not be flawless because of it, but we did our best to release a complete game. We hope you will understand the situation. We also hope you will have fun with our game, enjoy!
